And meanwhile costs slip away: overcharges on rental invoices go unseen, over-mileage penalties arrive with no warning, fines stay without a driver to assign them to. And the real cost of the fleet is never accurate and on time: rebuilding it takes weeks and several people: and by the time it lands, there's nothing left to decide. → Five departments to coordinate, and no data everyone can rely on. AI is only as powerful as the data beneath it. Every department is moving faster. Decisions pile up, requests multiply, and a fleet split across five teams can't answer them. Flottando makes the fleet one system, so the AI has something real to work with. editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 把车辆、员工、费用与维护资料统一为跨部门车队运营系统。
zh.judgment: 切口是减少跨部门重复行政，回报要看实际业务闭环而不是新仪表盘。
zh.replaces: 人力、财务和设施团队各用表格处理车辆分配、发票、期限和检查。
zh.product: 官网覆盖车辆分配、发票识别、费用、驾驶资格与维护期限，强调接入已有 HR、会计系统。安全和合规承诺为公司声明，本次未核验合同或部署。
zh.customer: 采购、财务、IT、人力和设施是明确用户。可以从最繁重的一个部门进入，但跨部门扩张需要清楚数据归属与更新责任。
zh.workflow: 公司描述导入车辆与费用资料，邀请团队，再管理期限、分配、文档和报告。真正交付应将异常指派给责任人，并向已有系统回传一致数据。
zh.business_model: 价目区分 Essentials、Professional 和 Enterprise，最后一档为定制价格，没有可比较数字。企业合同与 onboarding 的实际费用需确认，不把“迁移免费”推广成长期成本为零。
zh.traction: 客户故事入口有部分内容与首页重复，未取得独立效果对照。宣传中的工时和合规比例是公司口径，不能视为所有车队的保证。
zh.moat: 跨部门车辆记录、期限与系统集成可能形成粘性。传统车队软件、HR/会计系统和内部表格都是替代，连接质量决定是否真的少一个系统。
zh.funding_read: 早期资金可支持系统与销售，下一里程碑是从首部门到第二部门的持续采用。若每个客户都需大量定制，扩张效率仍有限。
zh.risks: 错误车辆分配或截止提醒会增加运营成本，数据同步与权限不同也可能产生冲突。员工信息、证照及文档需要明确处理责任。
zh.takeaway: 以共享车辆记录连接各部门的旧任务。把可操作异常和更新时间摆在前面，避免让协作停留在共同看图表。
zh.watch_next: 看跨部门复用、漏过期限、发票纠正与每车管理工时。对比迁移前后系统数和客户支持需求。

en.summary: A shared fleet system joining vehicles, employees, expenses and deadlines across departments.
en.judgment: Less repeated administration matters more than another dashboard.
en.replaces: Separate HR, finance and facilities spreadsheets for assignments, invoices and checks.
en.product: The site covers assignments, invoice extraction, expenses, driver checks and service deadlines with existing HR/accounting integration. Compliance claims and actual deployment were not independently verified.
en.customer: Procurement, finance, IT, HR and facilities are named users. One burdened department can be an entry point, but expansion needs clear ownership and updates.
en.workflow: The described path imports vehicles and costs, invites teams and manages deadlines, documents and reports. Exceptions should reach owners while consistent records return to existing systems.
en.business_model: Plans separate Essentials, Professional and custom Enterprise without comparable numerical prices. Contract and onboarding cost require confirmation; advertised free migration does not mean zero ongoing cost.
en.traction: Some customer-story content repeats the homepage and lacks independent comparisons. Time-saving and compliance percentages remain company claims, not guarantees for all fleets.
en.moat: Shared records, deadlines and integrations could create continuity. Fleet software, HR/accounting tools and spreadsheets compete; connection quality determines whether complexity falls.
en.funding_read: Capital supports product and sales. Persistent adoption by a second department is a milestone; bespoke work per client can constrain expansion efficiency.
en.risks: Wrong assignments or reminders create cost; synchronization and permission differences create conflicts. Employee documents require clear handling responsibility.
en.takeaway: Connect old departmental tasks through one vehicle record. Put actionable exceptions and update times before shared charts.
en.watch_next: Watch departmental reuse, missed deadlines, corrections and administration per vehicle, alongside system count and support before and after migration.
